the N allocation to the photosynthetic components in A. cruentum was not regulated according to the growth light conditions.
A. cruen-tus leaves invest N into the light-harvest- ing systems and into Rubisco, and that they are not able to increase the quantum yield of the photosyn- thetic process on the PFD basis.

the N allocation to Rubisco is the main factor determining the photosynthetic rates in A. cruentuss leaves.
